headlines.title: Inflation jumps to 3.7% as gas and diesel prices squeeze consumers ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: Prices rose across broad swaths of the economy in September, as high energy costs triggered by the Iran war pushed up costs in many major consumer categories.

headlines.title: Chick-fil-A bet on chicken 60 years ago. Now it’s America’s third largest restaurant chain.
headlines.description: The family-owned company reported nearly $24 billion in sales last year and recently expanded to Singapore and the United Kingdom.

headlines.title: Netflix to cut about 6% of worldwide staff
headlines.description: Netflix is eliminating about 1,000 jobs in a round of layoffs, according to a source with knowledge of the matter.

headlines.title: Social Security recipients will receive a 3.6% cost-of-living increase in 2027
headlines.description: Individual retirement benefits will climb an average of about $70 per month, the Social Security Administration said.

headlines.title: Soaring diesel prices fueling inflation, driving up cost of ‘just about everything,’ experts say
headlines.description: The final CPI report before the midterms is expected to reflect soaring energy costs compounded by higher airfares, pricier iPhones and rising car prices.

headlines.title: LinkedIn Reveals Its List of 2026's Top Startups
headlines.description: LinkedIn's Editor-in-Chief Dan Roth joins the 3rd Hour of TODAY to reveal the company's list of the top startups of 2026, spotlighting 50 young companies on the rise across the country. See the top five!

headlines.title: More Women Are Tapping Into Inner ‘Golden Girl’ to Save Money
headlines.description: The option to live out your golden years with friends in group homes is rising in popularity, especially among women. A recent survey found that 57% of women over the age of 50 would consider living with a friend. But, what is causing this uptick in the "Golden Girls" roommate trend? NBC's Vicky Nguyen met with three senior women to find out.

headlines.title: Chick-fil-A CEO Talks Portion Sizes, Prices, Staying Family-Owned
headlines.description: In his first-ever broadcast interview, Chick-fil-A CEO Andrew Cathy sits down with TODAY’s Craig Melvin for a wide-ranging interview in which he discusses portion sizes, prices, why he intertwines faith and business, the importance of the chain remaining family-owned, global expansion, political controversies and more. “I think that everybody that would be willing to walk in the door, they’ll see that they’re welcome to come eat with us,” he says about the company’s position on equal

headlines.title: Holiday Budget Tips to Make Sure You Don't Overspend
headlines.description: With the holiday season looming, the most wonderful time of the year can quickly become the most expensive and stressful time of the year. Finance expert and author Jean Chatzky joins TODAY with ways to save on gifts, travel, and more.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: To counteract a spooky economy, America prepares to spend on Halloween candy
headlines.description: This Halloween, rising prices for groceries and gas are pushing many consumers to cut back. But they’re not giving up Halloween candy.

headlines.title: Bank of America ordered to pay historic $1.2 billion over alleged sanctions law violations
headlines.description: The fine is the third-highest penalty ever issued by the Treasury Department, which found that the bank failed to report billions in suspicious transactions.
